text:
Maya (CS): Quick ask — CedarWorks (new pilot) needs two 60m enablement sessions next week: one APAC-friendly and one NA. Could we split content: Day1 config + Day2 live lab?

Ravi (Enablement): Yep. I can do Tue 08:30 AET (APAC) and Thu 11:00 PT (NA). Prefer to reuse same slide deck, different live lab datasets.

Lena (SuccessOps): Tue AET ok for me. Who will proctor the lab overlay? Need someone for Zoom breakout rooms.

Carlos (AM): I’ll join Thu. Heads-up: finance contact is listed as "at-risk"; do not attach contract docs to invites. We should keep renewal talk off the session agenda.

Maya (CS): Agreed. For "at-risk" accounts, CS will schedule a private renewal sync after enablement. Please add a CRM tag: enablement_followup=true.

Ravi (Enablement): Draft invite copy — feedback welcome:
```
Title: Redwood Enablement — CedarWorks onboarding
When: Tue 2026-04-14 08:30 AET (APAC)
      Thu 2026-04-16 11:00 PT (NA)
Duration: 60m
Format: 20m config walk, 30m guided lab, 10m wrap/Q&A
Prework: API key, sample dataset, run quick smoke test
Permissions: admin + eng only
Recording: optional (opt-out on join)
```

Lena (SuccessOps): Nice. Add automated reminders at 48h and 30m. Also enable a 90-second post-session pulse (emoji-based) and a 3-question follow-up.

SchedulerBot: Poll created: Tue 08:30 AET vs Tue 10:30 AET. 8 responses so far. (link)

Carlos (AM): For lab access, confirm SSO mapping + temporary dev keys. I’ll get the dev keys request in motion.

Maya (CS): Two operational items: 1) Exclude "finance" alias from calendar attachments for any account with tag renewal_risk; 2) Add a short "what to expect" note for RevOps.

Ravi (Enablement): I'll produce a 1-page pre-read + a 6-step checklist. Quick snippet to include for token troubleshooting:
```
If you see 401: verify API key in account settings and ensure correct org ID header.
If you see 429: reduce parallel requests or enable batching.
```

Lena (SuccessOps): I'll create the feedback form and configure retention for 90 days. Also will drop the facilitator rota into the invite.

SchedulerBot: Calendar invites sent: 18 recipients. Reminders queued.

Maya (CS): Action items:
- Ravi: finalize slides + pre-read link
- Lena: set reminders + feedback form + recording opt-out
- Carlos: provision dev keys for lab
- Maya: tag CRM, prepare renewal follow-up template

Ravi (Enablement): ETA EOD tomorrow for slides & pre-read. Will post links to #customer-updates.

Carlos (AM): I’ll ping RevOps and ensure finance alias excluded from attachments.

Maya (CS): Thanks team. If no blockers I'll confirm attendee list and close the loop by EOD tomorrow. :white_check_mark:

SchedulerBot: Reminder: 48h email scheduled for all accepted guests."
